log: Names rest on material names (BackPlaneMat, BottomLeftMat, ...), which basis cannot list. Each mesh is one flat square (2 triangles).

'at' is 0.5 everywhere because each mesh is a single quad, so the evidence gives no world position; the left/right/top/bottom words come from the material names only, plus the texture region (u 0-0.4 / 0.6-1, v 0.6-1 / 0-0.4) which agrees with them.
The back plane is 2x2, the four others 1x1; 'backdrop' as a class rests on the 'BackPlane' material name and the larger size.
